text:
Zoe (CS): Quick smoke-test runbook for trial day-0 that AMs can paste into kickoff notes. Keep it <5 bullets + one-liners they can run.
Arjun (Solutions): Love it 14 could we have a one-line prefill and a short checklist?
Zoe (CS): Yup. Top checklist for the 20min kickoff: 

- Prefill recent templates + last 30 messages
- Reserve a tiny warm pool (2 sessions) for first 6 hours
- Client retry: 3 attempts with exponential jitter
- Enable streaming fallback for UI spikes
- Capture 10 eval prompts for quality monitoring

Mateo (SRE): ops notes: set autoscale min_replicas=2 for 6h then scale to min=0. Add k/v prefill idempotency to avoid duplicate token burns. Add healthcheck: `GET /healthz` after warm-pool creation.
Zoe (CS): One-line prefill (pasteable):
Zoe (CS): ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"TRIAL123","idempotency_key":"onboard-$(date +%s)","items":[{"type":"template","name":"starter_v2"},{"type":"history","last_n":30}]}'
```
Arjun (Solutions): run no more than once per tenant per 12h during initial ramp. Customer-facing copy suggestion: "We preloaded a few templates to speed up your first replies. Reply here if you prefer we don't."
Felicia (PM): Renewal-risk mapping to attach to the ticket: day7 check => if active_queries_day7 < 0.3 * mean(active_queries_day1to3) OR avg_response_time > 1200ms then flag renewal-risk and schedule an enablement touch.
Zoe (CS): Telemetry / alert guidance: trigger if p50>400ms OR p99>1200ms OR streaming_error_rate>1%. Route alerts to #oncall-infra and tag assigned AM.
Mateo (SRE): demo tip: ask `infra-bot` to silence deploy noise for that tenant for short demos: `infra-bot silence deploys 45m tenant:TRIAL123`
infra-bot: OK 14 deploy alerts muted for 45m for tenant:TRIAL123 :white_check_mark:
Zoe (CS): I'll add this as a 1-pager to the CS template library and drop the curl/snippets into the kickoff email.
Arjun (Solutions): I'll add a tiny sequence diagram (prefill -> warm pool -> streaming fallback) to the email.
Zoe (CS): Thanks y'all 680. Sending to template folder now.
